video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Warriors Postgame Interviews 11/9/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on the team's poor defensive response against the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: They came in, punched us in the mouth, we didn't respond the right way.
quotes.quote: No, it's not a flush it. It's not. We got our asses kicked. No other way to put it. They came in, punched us in the mouth, we didn't respond the right way. It's two nights in a row we've allowed our offense to dictate our defense. 139 last night, 138 tonight. To understand how we want to play, sometimes you got to get hit in the dang mouth, and we got hit in the mouth twice. How we will respond is going to say a lot about us, and that's all of us.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley did not mince words after the Pelicans allowed 138 points tonight. We got our asses kicked. They came in, punched us in the mouth, we did not respond the right way.

structured.context: Head coach Jamahl Mosley addresses the media following the Pelicans' defensive struggles in a loss against the Warriors.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley expresses confidence in the team's competitive nature
quotes.excerpt: It's a fighting group. You have a lot of guys with a competitive edge and dog to them.
quotes.quote: I'm confident in this group. It's a fighting group. You have a lot of guys with a competitive edge and dog to them. Just got to continue to bring it out together. I think that's the big key for us as we continue to move forward and not allow offense to dictate what our defense does. You score 120 something last night, you get 87 tonight, but you give up 138, 139. It's not good enough, and who we're going to become and who we're building into and who we're going to be, it has to be the defensive end.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the Pelicans need to stop letting their offense dictate their defense after giving up 138 points tonight. He remains confident in the group's competitive edge.

structured.context: Head coach Jamahl Mosley discusses his confidence in the team's competitive nature and the need to improve defensively.
